A fixed technology and listing service fee, billed in advance. Not a
per-enquiry charge, not a commission, and never a share of the fee an
advocate charges a client. Keep it that way — the whole positioning in
about.html, terms.html and the Bar Council note depends on it.
billingNote: Billed in advance for the period you choose. Prices are per month; you pay the whole period up front.
hiddenPricesNote: Billed in advance for the period you choose. Message us on WhatsApp for the current figures and we will send them to you in writing before you pay anything.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.blurb: Paid one month at a time. Stop whenever you like — the listing runs to the end of the month you have paid for.

plans.name: Six months
plans.blurb: Paid for half a year in advance, at a lower monthly rate than the monthly plan.

plans.name: Yearly
plans.blurb: Paid for the year in advance, at the lowest monthly rate.

_footnotesComment: Each entry is either a plain string, or an object with `text` plus a `link` — {href, label} — appended as a real link. Keep the Terms of Use link: the refund terms have to be reachable from the price.
footnotes: The listing and the microsite are priced separately — you can take the listing on its own.
